GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat Outside Leader .5 Lengths 800m, went back inside soon after Straightening Up , only battled at the one pace last 200m # did not finish off

Jumped okay & Went Forward to 1 length Lead on fence, Held Together in front, joined at 550m and immediately headed, trailed 0.75 Lengths turning, hugged fence rounding turn and Lost Ground in Straight # weak once headed

Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 6 Lengths Four Wide , moved up a bit and in Two Wide at the 850m, little change to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Some Ground 3 Wide in Straight # back/battled fairly

Jumped Ok Not Bustled from Outside Settled Down 6th Four Wide 4-5 Lengths Under Pressure Straightening Up wider, couldn't quicken couldn't finish off had no favours 1st sat 2nd - this was # never on the track
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced four wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down last 8 Lengths 600m last 3 Wide 7 Lengths Straightened Up 7th only held ground Straight # back/one paced run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Reared on jumping, resulting in its rider being unbalanced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began well. Rollld fwd & raced 3rd 3 Wide No Cover (2L from lead) early . Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to quicken Four Wide @ 500m. Puahed along Five Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 300m & outsprinted Four Wide in last 200m. # Wide/fair effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok drifted back settling down 5 Lengths off the lead 3 Wide had cover (700m), Hard Ridden Wide out cornering, no run on # did nothing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Passing the 500m, was awkwardly placed close to heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Four Wide , Drifted Back to 7.5 Lengths Four Wide turning, couldn't come on in Straight # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced four wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Two Wide (5L from lead). Held Ground until pushed to quicken Two Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured on rail @ 300m & ground home steadily on inside in last 200m. # Even effort.
began well Settled Down 4th Wide 3 Lengths took sit 600m up turn last 200m weak late # average effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Touch slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (6L from lead). Stayed @ rear on inside midrace & pushed to chase 3 Wide @ 450m. Chasing Five Wide (7L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid in @ 250m. Passed tired horses in last 200m. # Fair from rear.

Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Wide trailing 0.75 Lengths , Drifted Back to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Ground in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed bilateral epistaxis. Provisions of AR79(4) invoked.] # Bled. 3-month ban.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding bled both nostrils. Trainer was advised provisions of AR79(4) applies. Cleared to resume.
